in_sanskrit.name: भगवान्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who gives Bhagya (fortune, blessings) to his devotees.

in_hindi.name: भगवान
in_hindi.long_meaning: देवोताओं के लिए भाग्य (शुभकार्य, प्रशान्ति) देनेवाला

in_tamil.name: பகவான்

in_marathi.name: Bhagawan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhagawan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who has all the divine qualities and powers. Worshipped as the ultimate deity in Hinduism.

in_bengali.name: Bhagawan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord, God
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhagawan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The one who has all the divine qualities and powers. Worshipped as the ultimate deity in Hinduism.
